mapper.select: /* CastDepMapper.retrieveSmltDepList */ SELECT TIME, DEP_NUM, SUM(WTNG_PSG_CNT) as WTNG_PSG_CNT, FLOOR(AVG(PRCS_HR)) as PRCS_HR, FLOOR(AVG(WTNG_HR)) as WTNG_HR FROM ( SELECT A.YMD, A.TIME, B.TMNL_ID, A.WTNG_PSG_CNT, A.PRCS_HR, A.WTNG_HR, B.DEP_NUM FROM ( SELECT A.SMLT_ID, REPLACE(SUBSTR(A.SMLT_ACTL_DT, 0, 10), '/', '') YMD, REPLACE(SUBSTR(A.SMLT_ACTL_DT, 12, 5), ':', '') TIME, PSG_FCLT_CD, A.WTNG_PSG_CNT, A.AVG_PRCS_HR as PRCS_HR, A.AVG_WTNG_HR as WTNG_HR FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_RSLT_DTL A WHERE A.SMLT_ID = #{smltId} AND A.WTNG_PSG_CNT > 0 ) A INNER JOIN ( SELECT PSG_FCLT_CD, UP_PSG_FCLT_CD, PSG_FCLT_NM, TMNL_ID, SMLT_FCLT_NM, SUBSTR(PSG_FCLT_CD, 4, 1) AS DEP_NUM FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_PSG_FCLT B WHERE 1 = 1 AND B.TMNL_ID = #{tmnlId} AND B.UP_PSG_FCLT_CD IN ('LGT') AND B.USE_YN = 'Y' ) B ON A.PSG_FCLT_CD = B.PSG_FCLT_CD WHERE 1 = 1 ) GROUP BY TIME, DEP_NUM ORDER BY TIME, DEP_NUM

/* CastDepMapper.retrieveDepFcltList */ SELECT SUBSTR(B.PSG_FCLT_CD, 4, 1) AS DEP_NUM, B.PSG_FCLT_NM AS DEP_NM, B.USE_YN FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_PSG_FCLT B WHERE 1 = 1 AND B.TMNL_ID = #{tmnlId} -- 미운영 출국장도 화면 하단 칩으로 내려가므로 USE_YN 으로 거르지 않는다 AND B.UP_PSG_FCLT_CD IN ('LGT') ORDER BY DEP_NUM

/* CastDepMapper.retrieveDepOperHrList */ SELECT A.GATE_NO AS DEP_NUM, B.OPER_BGNG_1_HR AS BGN_HM, B.OPER_END_1_HR AS END_HM FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_FCLTY_OPNG_TBL_DPTGT_ATRB A INNER JOIN ( SELECT C.OPER_HR_CRLTN_SN, C.ELMNT_SN, B.TMNL_ID, B.FCLT_SE_CD, C.FCLTY_TYPE_ID, C.OPER_BGNG_YMD, NVL(C.OPER_END_YMD, '21001231') AS OPER_END_YMD, C.OPER_BGNG_1_HR, C.OPER_END_1_HR FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_ENTGT_DPTGT_OPER_HR_INFO A INNER JOIN PMOWN.TN_PM_ENTGT_DPTGT_OPER_HR_ELMNT B ON A.OPER_HR_CRLTN_SN = B.OPER_HR_CRLTN_SN INNER JOIN PMOWN.TN_PM_ENTGT_DPTGT_OPER_HR_MNG C ON A.OPER_HR_CRLTN_SN = C.OPER_HR_CRLTN_SN AND B.ELMNT_SN = C.ELMNT_SN -- DPL 배포됨 WHERE A.OPER_HR_STTS_CD = 'DPL' ) B ON A.TMNL_ID = B.TMNL_ID AND A.FCLT_SE_CD = B.FCLT_SE_CD AND A.GATE_NO = B.FCLTY_TYPE_ID WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.DPTGT_ATRB_ID = REGEXP_REPLACE(#{dgRsrcId}, 'FOTDG|FacilityOpeningTable_DepartureGate', '') AND A.TMNL_ID = #{tmnlId} AND #{ymd} BETWEEN B.OPER_BGNG_YMD AND B.OPER_END_YMD ORDER BY DEP_NUM

/* CastDepMapper.retrieveScCntList */ SELECT A.GATE_NO AS DEP_NUM, A.FCLTY_CNT AS SC_CNT FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_FCLTY_OPNG_TBL_SCRTY_CNTRL_ATRB A WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.SCRTY_CNTRL_ATRB_ID = REGEXP_REPLACE(#{scRsrcId}, 'FOTSC|FacilityOpeningTable_SecurityControl', '') AND A.TMNL_ID = #{tmnlId} ORDER BY DEP_NUM
